## Expression on this line

Media at amber Stage 9 is the **mass communications apparatus operating as instrument of the
sacred national order**. Broadcasting, the press, the modern printed-broadsheet, radio, the
modern news-aggregator, in-route application-of-print-modern-magazine — institutions of mass
communication exist and operate at industrial scale. What has not yet emerged is the operating
principle that mass communication serves *a critical watch-dog function independent of those
in power* — a fourth-estate *judge-and-jury* role with legal-publisher independence. (This is the
orange breakthrough.) Until the orange turn, mass communication's role is to manufacture
in-group consent and to de-legitimize dissent.

The constitutive choice is to *mobilize* mass-communication output toward the sacred order: the
in-group's preferred civic-religion, civilizational narrative, in-group heroes, in-group wronged-
parties, out-group enemies and threats. Selection-of-coverage, framing, editorial-selection and
broadcast-time allocation are all governed by loyalty rather than by a critical-watch-dog
discipline. There is genuine professional-organization-of-the-trade, markets, and rule-of-law
apparatus; nevertheless, the *operative* use of mass-media is in-group mobilization rather than
a watch-dog role independent of factional pressures.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion — what a higher CoG must keep from amber-9)

- **UL:** the practitioner's professional-vocation *we serve by covering the news*, with the
  disciplined-feel of craft and the dignity-of-the-trade on the line.
- **UR:** mass-communication infrastructure; the literal-physical networks of broadcast and
  print, the news-organization, the printing-press, the satellite, the editorial chain.
- **LL:** shared-modern-media-civic-religion: the dominant civic-modern story of mass
  communication as a public-domain called to engage the public.
- **LR:** codified broadcasting license regulation, the press statutory discipline, broadcast-
  allocation infrastructure, content moderation statutory skeleton.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction (clinging to amber-9):** **mobilizing press** — selection-of-coverage and
  framing organized-energy to *advance* an in-group-membership position rather than to
  *critically-probe* the polity; countervailing voices are minor-by-design or marginalized-as-
  alien; the press-as-amplifier-of-membership-stewardship-becomes press-as-amplifier-of-
  civilizational-claim.
- **Dark allergy (amber-9 foundation skipped/fragile):** mass-media-industrial scale without
  professionalized discipline — the appearance of mass media without the substance of a
  shared-craft-discipline, the newsroom-without-rule-of-craft.
- **Golden addiction (grasping Orange prematurely):** **fourth-estate-theater** — performative
  watch-dog language (editorial-statements on independence, *public-editor* columns, *press-
  ombudsmen* statements, *diversity-and-inclusion* mastheads) when editorial-decisioning remains
  operational-press-and-publish-by-slant; orange-form, amber-substance.
- **Golden allergy (Jonah / refusing the Orange emergence):** nativist-refusal — *the press in
  our country's interest*, refusal of the watch-dog discipline as alien or anti-people;
  refusal of the orange worldcentric-press frame.

## Diagnostic cues (universal signal-types)

Falsifiable signal *types* that place a media-system holon at **amber Stage 9**.

- **Coverage-versus-membership-coverage pattern.** Patterns-of-coverage (topic-aggregate) on
  state-related news correlate with the in-group's preferred narrative more than with
  adjudicated-evidence-base. Critical coverage of state policy is by-fractional-of-coverage
  rather than at a publishable-equal-rate.
- **Cyclical-mobilization framing.** Issue-by-issue framing of news oscillates around the
  rhythms of in-group mobilization rather than around evidence-base.
- **Editorial-page loyalty-rate.** Editorial-rate-of-state-support-versus-state-not
  consistently-above the cross-spectrum vim-coverage-rates; the in-group line is the default.
- **Cross-coverage-network by political-alignment.** Public-coverage-and-sources-aggregate-
  selection clusters with the in-group's canonical media, especially around contested-political-
  alignment issue.
- **Sources-and-quotation-balance unreflected.** Default-source quotation ratio: members and
  sympathizers of the in-group appear as sources and quote-subjects at higher rates than the
  evidence-basis-of-the-coverage warrants.
- **Watch-dog-drop-off.** Recurrent watch-dog-style coverage observable at occasionally-
  selected issues, statistically-not-aligned with the in-group pattern, with topics covered
  not constituting the structural-base-rate.
- **Editorial-versus-news resource gap.** Statistically-disparate-investigative-resource-
  allocation between coverage-aligned-with-state-policy and coverage-other.

## Sources, joints, open questions

- **Sources:** Wilber, *Integral Psychology* (altitude/amber); Beck & Cowan, *Spiral Dynamics*
  (ethnocentric stabilization); Commons/MHC Order 8 (Primary); Kegan, *In Over Our Heads*
  (order 3 → 4); Habermas, *The Structural Transformation of the Public Sphere*;
  McLuhan, *Understanding Media*; Herman & Chomsky, *Manufacturing Consent and
  Mainstream-Media* (described at its generically-applicable level); Hallin, *The
  "Uncensored War"* (the span of media-coverage-of-war-and-state as generality);
  Bennett's index of press-politics work as a generic form.

- **Open joints:** What institutional carriers carry the amber media system's *positive* civic-
  modern moment (the standing-mass-communication infrastructure, the editorial-disciplines, the
  shared-modern-civic-modern frame) into the orange turn? What structural pre-conditions are
  required for an amber-mobilizing-press to dismount its loyalty-leaning without destabilizing
  the infrastructure that makes critical-coverage possible?

  `media/11-abstract-emerge`; cross-link the `governance` line at Stage 9 (membership-cousin)
